title: Minimum sufficient resident projection from canonical semantic state
research_question: Can a canonical semantic state be treated as backing truth while a smaller per-work runtime projection preserves decision, verification, recovery, and capability requirements?
hypothesis: A dependency-closed projection compiled from all declared contract planes can be much smaller than the canonical universe while remaining contract-equivalent to full residency; a decision-only slice will produce false confidence by dropping verification or recovery requirements.
primary_oracles: compiled contract equals full contract for every work unit
removing any compiled atom breaks at least one declared contract plane
decision-only projection is detected as insufficient
compiled byte-rounds are lower than full byte-rounds
failure_conditions: selected atom with no contract-plane witness
decision-only adversary incorrectly passes the complete contract
next_gate: Add measured topology and migration costs, then test re-planning after resource observation before any physical-PCG performance claim.
